chosen_by: Claude, 2026-10-24 (Jeff delegated the choice of the 25 molecules); for Jeff to check against CHEM-312
how: The groups and counts a second-year organic student should find in each structure, written by reading the structure, before any pattern was run on it. Never generated from web/public/functional-groups.json, which is what this file tests. Names are those in functional-groups.json; a group not listed must not be shown.

molecules.name: ethyl acetate
molecules.checks: an ester's single-bonded O is not also an ether

molecules.name: aspirin
molecules.checks: ester and acid side by side; the ester O on the ring is neither an ether nor a phenol

molecules.name: 4-methoxybenzoic acid
molecules.checks: an aryl ether beside an acid; the acid's OH is not an alcohol

molecules.name: methylparaben
molecules.checks: ester vs phenol vs ether: the methoxy O belongs to the ester

molecules.name: acetic anhydride
molecules.checks: one anhydride, not two esters, and its central O is not an ether

molecules.name: vanillin
molecules.checks: phenol and ether on the same ring, with an aldehyde

molecules.name: 4-hydroxybenzyl alcohol
molecules.checks: an OH on the ring is a phenol; on the CH2 it is a 1° alcohol

molecules.name: paracetamol
molecules.checks: an N on the ring that carries a C=O is an amide, not an amine

molecules.name: lidocaine
molecules.checks: amide and 3° amine in one molecule

molecules.name: procaine
molecules.checks: an aryl NH2 is a 1° amine and the NEt2 a 3° amine; the ester O is not an ether

molecules.name: N,N-dimethylformamide
molecules.checks: a formyl C-H on N is an amide, not an aldehyde, and its N is not a 3° amine

molecules.name: glycerol
molecules.checks: counts: two 1° alcohols and one 2°

molecules.name: 2-butanol
molecules.checks: 2° alcohol

molecules.name: tert-butanol
molecules.checks: 3° alcohol

molecules.name: propargyl alcohol
molecules.checks: terminal alkyne beside a 1° alcohol

molecules.name: cholesterol
molecules.checks: a ring 2° alcohol and a ring alkene in a large molecule with stereocentres

molecules.name: diethylamine
molecules.checks: 2° amine

molecules.name: L-cysteine
molecules.checks: thiol; an amine on the carbon next to an acid is not an amide

molecules.name: benzoyl chloride
molecules.checks: Cl on a C=O is an acid chloride: not an alkyl halide, not a ketone

molecules.name: 2-chloro-2-methylpropane
molecules.checks: a tertiary alkyl halide

molecules.name: epichlorohydrin
molecules.checks: the three-membered ring's O is an epoxide, not an ether; the CH2Cl is an alkyl halide

molecules.name: benzonitrile
molecules.checks: C≡N is a nitrile, not an alkyne or an amine

molecules.name: carvone
molecules.checks: α,β-unsaturated ketone: the ring C=C and the isopropenyl C=C are two alkenes

molecules.name: cinnamaldehyde
molecules.checks: the C=C between ring and aldehyde is an alkene, not part of the arene

molecules.name: acetophenone
molecules.checks: an aryl ketone
